scope.excluded_work: all catalog problems and research tracks other than #021/B7, #022/B2, and #023

question: If exact online windowing misses almost every one-microsecond deadline, is the first failing boundary the correlated matching kernel, Python window bookkeeping, or synchronous packing/socket/feedback transport?

known_before_preregistration.disclosure: the prior result already exposes coarse input, decode/commit, feedback, and end-to-end timing summaries; no direct no-socket rerun, matching-kernel vector, edge-mapping vector, commit-propagation vector, attribution classification, or new relative speedup has been observed

corpus_contract.source: the identical frozen 1,024-shot X/Z corpora and full-block correlated predictions used by the online-window result

attribution_contract.window_algorithm: unchanged sequential 3d=18 overlapping recovery with d=6 commits and 2d=12 look-ahead
attribution_contract.sync_path: the existing packed same-process Unix socket input, matching, correction propagation, and reverse feedback acknowledgement path
attribution_contract.direct_path: the same compiled windows, syndrome bytes, matching objects, component mapping, correction propagation, and logical frame, but detector arrivals are copied directly and feedback is read directly without packing or sockets
attribution_contract.timed_mode_order: sync_then_direct on even shot indices and direct_then_sync on odd shot indices
attribution_contract.raw_vectors_required: little-endian uint64 nanoseconds for sync total and phases plus direct total and every direct phase
semantic_requirements: direct path equals all 1,024 frozen correlated full-block predictions in each basis
sync rerun equals the first 128 frozen correlated full-block predictions in each basis
direct and sync rerun leave every committed region and final syndrome with zero residual
direct and sync predictions agree on every timed row

timing_contract.primary_statistic: nearest-rank p99 microseconds per committed syndrome layer
timing_contract.wall_clock_replay_policy: raw bytes and arithmetic are auditable, while a later independent run may reproduce the classification without requiring identical nanoseconds

classification_rule.rule: after the semantic veto, select the first stage that fails the p99 and miss-fraction gate in either X or Z: matching_kernel, then direct_end_to_end, then sync_end_to_end
classification_rule.interpretation: a classification localizes the first measured software boundary only and does not establish a hardware bottleneck

kaggle_inspired_evaluation.verification_veto: semantic correctness, clean residuals, source hashes, and frozen predictions are checked before any timing improvement is credited
kaggle_inspired_evaluation.reference_relative_cost: for each basis report sync_path_p99/direct_path_p99 only after the semantic veto passes
kaggle_inspired_evaluation.aggregate: geometric mean across X and Z of the two reference-relative p99 speedups
kaggle_inspired_evaluation.absolute_guardrail: relative speedup cannot waive the frozen one-microsecond p99 and one-percent miss limits
kaggle_inspired_evaluation.confidence_analogy: the competition prices decoder failure using an upper confidence bound; this experiment instead keeps exact fixed-corpus equality and tail/deadline statistics as separate vetoes

hard_boundaries.reason: both execution paths remain same-host Python processes without a QPU, measurement stack, controller, asynchronous hardware queue, cryogenic link, or device feedback path

execution_guard.preflight_before_publication: real DEM structure and all-zero syndrome only; zero stochastic candidate shots and zero direct-path timing observations
